title: Automate Handwritten Zoho Creator Orders with AI Vision #Shorts
description:
Automate data entry by using Zoho Creator and AI Vision. This workflow captures photos of handwritten orders, extracts data via API, and populates Creator forms automatically.

1. Create an Image upload field inside a Zoho Creator custom form for the field team's order photo.
2. Attach a Deluge custom script to the form submission using invokeurl to send the image base64 to an AI Vision endpoint.
3. Parse the returned JSON items and automatically loop through to insert rows into your Creator subform.

API / tool used:
- name: OpenAI Vision API
- endpoint: POST https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions
- scope: None
- docs: OpenAI Vision Documentation

Code (deluge) - Zoho Creator Form Workflow - On Success:
img_payload = {"image": input.Order_Photo.getURL()};
response = invokeurl [url: 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions' type: POST parameters: img_payload];
// Parse response and loop through line items...

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation
